diagnosis.cause: TemporaryDirectory -> mkdtemp -> os.mkdir(path,0o700). Windows CPython creates a protected DACL granting SYSTEM, Administrators and owner; parent sandbox access grants are not inherited. Child file creation, directory traversal and cleanup fail under the restricted token.
diagnosis.classification: Test temporary-directory handling / Windows sandbox ACL interaction; not production scientific implementation.
diagnosis.evidence: Installed tempfile.mkdtemp source calls mkdir 0700; parent ACL contains inherited sandbox grants; reading child ACLs is itself denied. CPython v3.12.14 posixmodule.c lines 5024-5040 establishes the protected ACL mechanism. Replacement inherited-ACL directories successfully support writes, exclusive-open and cleanup in both test runs.

failures.operation: PermissionError [Errno 13] writing preflight.json; cleanup also PermissionError [WinError 5]
PermissionError [Errno 13] exclusive-open receipt.json; cleanup also PermissionError [WinError 5]

repair: Test-local scratch_directory context manager: UUID child, mkdir 0777 on Windows to inherit parent ACL (0700 elsewhere); containment check before cleanup. Two call sites replaced. No mocks, assertions or production calculations changed.
remaining_environment_artifacts: The two original inaccessible tmp directories remain untouched; git status still warns about their permissions. No new test directory remains.
